description:
The world changers all share one trait: assertiveness.

Confidence isn’t about being perfect. It’s about believing you’ll figure things out as you go.

If you want to make an impact, step in and own your agency.

What’s one area in your life where you could be more assertive but haven’t yet? What’s holding you back? Comment below 👇

 🎥 @greatness podcast with @lewishowes
transcript: I actively coach four billionaires. Their number one trait is assertiveness. Assertiveness? Yeah, they assert themselves into situations because they believe they'll figure it out. That's confidence. Confidence is, I believe in my ability to figure things out. Confidence is not perfection. It is, I'll get in motion, I'll figure it out. And so if you want to change the world, you have to assert yourself into the world. You can't be a passive person. You have to have high agency.
